prompt: A wide medieval battlefield at dusk where five armored soldiers in dented steel plate, spread across the full width of the frame, are all simultaneously annihilated by a colossal vertical shaft of radiant white-gold holy light slamming down from a parted storm sky. Each soldier is caught mid-collapse, dissolving into the searing column, their silhouettes burning away to ash and bone. The blinding pillar of divine judgment splits the dark field down the middle. The background is a churning bruise-purple sky cracked open above, with the only source of light being the lethal white-gold column.

A towering radiant angel in bone-white robes and golden plate hovers at the center of a wide battlefield, both glowing arms outstretched, having just unleashed a divine reckoning. On her left, three armored knights crumble to drifting ash; on her right, three monstrous beasts dissolve to skeletons in the same blast of white-gold light. All six victims are fully visible, the same scale, collapsing simultaneously. The background is a dim ash-grey battlefield at dawn, the only strong light radiating outward from the angel.
